name: Pioneering Technology Corp.
summary: Pioneering Technology Corp. engages in developing, manufacturing, and sale of thermo-based technology solutions in Canada and the United States. It offers SmartBurner, a plug-and-play solution for electric coil stoves; SmartRange, a fire protection for electric glass-top stove; and Smart Micro, a microwave safety solution to prevent microwave fires and nuisance/ false smoke alarm activations. The company also provides SmartBurner Polish to restore, protect, and maintain SmartBurner's original appearance. Pioneering Technology Corp. is based in Mississauga, Canada.
